stories.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Adds $70 Million in Ethereum, Holdings Reach 5.93 Million ETH
stories.summary: Bitmine Immersion Technologies, chaired by Tom Lee, bought another $70 million of Ethereum. Its total holdings now stand at 5.93 million ETH. The purchase continues a pattern of steady, large-scale ETH accumulation by the company.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitmine is one of the largest corporate holders of ETH, so its buying pace is a visible signal of institutional demand for Ethereum.
whatToWatch: Whether Bitmine keeps buying at a similar pace
Any updated target for total ETH holdings
questions: How is Bitmine funding these purchases?

sources.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Adds $70 Million in Ethereum, Holdings Reach 5.93 Million ETH

stories.title: Visa Adds Onchain Credit to Its Stablecoin Card Business
stories.summary: Visa is expanding its stablecoin-linked card program to include onchain credit. This builds on the card business Visa has already been growing around stablecoins.
stories.whyItMatters: A major payment network adding credit features on top of stablecoin cards points to deeper mainstream integration of crypto into everyday payments.
whatToWatch: Which issuers or partners roll this out first
Which stablecoins and markets are included
questions: How does the credit feature work under the hood — is it collateralized by stablecoin balances?

sources.title: Visa brings onchain credit to its growing stablecoin card business

stories.title: Bitcoin Tests $78.3K Support as Oil Prices Hit Three-Month High
stories.summary: Bitcoin is testing a key support level near $78,300 as US crude oil prices reach a three-month high. The move follows a weekend in which bitcoin struggled to hold above $80,000.
stories.whyItMatters: Rising oil prices feed inflation worries, and inflation worries move Fed rate expectations, which have become a direct driver of bitcoin's short-term price action.
whatToWatch: Whether the $78.3K level holds
This week's inflation data and its effect on bitcoin
questions: Is the pressure on bitcoin coming mainly from oil-driven inflation fears or broader risk-off sentiment?

sources.title: Bitcoin faces key support test at $78.3K as US crude oil hits three-month high
Bitcoin chips away at weekend upside as $80K hangs in the balance

stories.title: Strive Buys $109 Million in Bitcoin, Preferred Stock Nears $1 Billion
stories.summary: Strive bought $109 million of bitcoin as part of its ongoing treasury strategy. The preferred stock it uses to fund these purchases is approaching $1 billion outstanding.
stories.whyItMatters: It shows another corporate treasury scaling up bitcoin purchases through preferred-stock financing, a funding model spreading beyond Strategy.
whatToWatch: Further preferred stock issuance
Strive's total bitcoin holdings over time
questions: How sustainable is this financing model if bitcoin's price drops?

sources.title: Strive Buys $109 Million in Bitcoin, Pushes Preferred Stock Toward $1 Billion

stories.title: Strategy Skips Bitcoin Buy to Repurchase $176M of STRC Preferred Shares
stories.summary: Strategy did not make its usual weekly bitcoin purchase. Instead, it spent $176 million repurchasing its STRC preferred shares.
stories.whyItMatters: Strategy's bitcoin buys have been a near-constant rhythm in the market, so a pause to prioritize its preferred shares is a notable shift in capital allocation.
whatToWatch: Whether bitcoin purchases resume next week
STRC share price following the repurchase
questions: Why did Strategy prioritize the preferred-share repurchase over its usual bitcoin buy?

sources.title: Strategy skips Bitcoin buy to repurchase $176M of STRC preferred shares

stories.title: Ethereum's Supply Debate: High Staking Yields vs. Long-Term ETH Value
stories.summary: A debate is building over Ethereum's token supply policy. Higher staking yields reward stakers but may dilute the value of ETH held by everyone else, forcing a tradeoff.
stories.whyItMatters: Changes to ETH issuance and staking economics directly affect long-term valuation and how holders and validators are incentivized.
whatToWatch: Any formal proposals to change ETH issuance or staking rewards
Staking participation trends
questions: What specific proposal, if any, is driving this debate right now?

sources.title: The fight over Ethereum’s supply is forcing a choice between high staking yields and the value of your ETH

stories.title: Bitcoin Miner Spends Millions in BTC on Compute Instead of Building Treasury
stories.summary: A bitcoin mining company has spent millions of dollars worth of BTC to buy computing capacity. Newly mined coins are not being added back to its treasury as they once were.
stories.whyItMatters: It signals miners shifting capital toward compute infrastructure, likely for AI workloads, rather than pure bitcoin accumulation, changing how investors should value miner stocks.
whatToWatch: Further disclosures on the miner's treasury balance
Whether other miners follow the same strategy
questions: Which miner is this, and what is the compute capacity being used for?

sources.title: Bitcoin miner burns through millions in BTC to buy compute, but new coins are not returning to treasury

stories.title: Bitmine Buys 28,000 ETH, Nears Completion of Treasury Goal
stories.summary: Bitmine bought another 28,000 ETH, bringing its progress to 97% of its stated treasury accumulation goal.
stories.whyItMatters: As Bitmine nears its target, the pace of one of the market's largest ETH buyers may soon slow, which matters for anyone tracking institutional ETH demand.
whatToWatch: When Bitmine reaches 100% of its stated goal
Whether it sets a new, higher target afterward
questions: What happens to Bitmine's buying pace once the goal is reached?

sources.title: Bitmine buys 28k ETH, completes 97% of treasury accumulation goal

stories.title: Is Bitcoin Too Volatile for Retirement Savings?
stories.summary: A commentary piece weighs whether bitcoin's price swings make it unsuitable as a retirement investment, as more retirement accounts gain access to crypto.
stories.whyItMatters: The suitability of bitcoin in retirement accounts is a live policy and personal-finance question as access expands.
whatToWatch: Any regulatory guidance on crypto in retirement accounts
questions: What volatility threshold or time horizon is the piece using to make its case?

sources.title: Is Bitcoin too volatile to risk your retirement on?

stories.title: Mexico Quadruple Homicide Linked to Alleged Bitcoin Robbery Attempt
stories.summary: Four people were killed in Mexico in an incident authorities are linking to an alleged attempted robbery targeting bitcoin holdings. Details of the case are still emerging.
stories.whyItMatters: It is a stark reminder that self-custody of bitcoin carries real physical-security risk, not just cyber risk.
whatToWatch: Updates from the investigation
Any charges filed
questions: What evidence links the killings to a bitcoin robbery attempt?

sources.title: Mexico quadruple homicide tied to alleged Bitcoin robbery attempt

stories.title: Cronos Rolled Back Two Hours of Transactions to Reverse $111 Million DeFi Exploit
stories.summary: The Cronos network erased about two hours of transaction history to undo a DeFi exploit that had drained roughly $111 million. The rollback reversed the effects of the attack on-chain.
stories.whyItMatters: A chain-level rollback to undo an exploit is a major intervention that raises fresh questions about decentralization and who controls the network in a crisis.
whatToWatch: Community and validator reaction to the rollback
Whether affected users are made whole
Any protocol changes to prevent a repeat
questions: Who decided to execute the rollback, and under what process?
Does this set a precedent for handling future exploits on Cronos or similar chains?

sources.title: Cronos Erased Two Hours of Transactions to Reverse $111 Million DeFi Exploit

stories.title: Rising Oil Prices and Inflation Fears Threaten Bitcoin Below $80K Ahead of CPI
stories.summary: Oil prices nearing $100 are complicating expectations for Friday's CPI report, stoking fears that inflation will stay elevated. That macro backdrop is adding pressure to bitcoin, which is already hovering below $80,000.
stories.whyItMatters: Inflation data and Fed policy expectations have become a direct driver of bitcoin's price, so this week's CPI report carries added weight.
whatToWatch: Friday's CPI report
Fed commentary in response to the data
Bitcoin's price reaction around the release
questions: How much of the oil price rise is temporary versus a lasting supply issue?

sources.title: Fed inflation trap threatens Bitcoin below $80k as $100 oil blindsides Friday’s CPI report
